intro: Jason's Deli is the American deli chain known for its muffalettas, big sandwiches, the Garden Fresh Salad Bar, loaded baked potatoes, and free soft-serve ice cream. It leans into fresh, additive-conscious ingredients and generous portions, with a 'Lighter' option on many items. Below is the full Jason's Deli menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: At Jason's Deli, a whole muffaletta is about $17.09 (a quarter $8.89), the Reuben the Great is $13.99, and salads run about $11 to $12. The Garden Fresh Salad Bar is $10.29, soups are $5.39 a cup or $6.99 a bowl, and loaded baked potatoes are around $10.79 to $11.09. The muffaletta and the salad bar are the icons, and soft-serve is free.
hot_deal: Jason's Deli value: the free soft-serve ice cream with a dine-in meal is the best-known perk, and the salad bar ($10.29) is all-you-can-build. A quarter muffaletta ($8.89) or a cup of soup ($5.39) are the cheapest ways in, and kids eat cheap ($4.69 to $5.59). The Deli Dollars rewards program drops offers. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is a muffaletta at Jason's Deli?
faqs.a: A whole muffaletta is about $17.09, a half $11.19, and a quarter $8.89 (a quarter 'special' with a side is $10.79). It comes as ham and salami or turkey with the signature olive mix on a round loaf. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is the salad bar at Jason's Deli?
faqs.a: The Garden Fresh Salad Bar is about $10.29 for all-you-can-build. It is one of the main draws, with fresh greens, toppings and dressings, and it can be added to many meals. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: Does Jason's Deli have free ice cream?
faqs.a: Yes. Jason's Deli is known for free soft-serve ice cream with a dine-in meal, a long-standing perk. You can help yourself at the soft-serve machine, which makes it a favorite with families.

Jason's Deli publishes nutrition information in its restaurants and online, but item calories are not reproduced here and are left blank rather than guessed. The chain does offer 'Lighter' versions of many sandwiches, salads and potatoes for a smaller portion.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Jason's Deli?
faqs.a: Favorites include the muffaletta, the Reuben the Great, the Garden Fresh Salad Bar, the loaded baked potatoes, and the free soft-serve ice cream.
